messages:
mira: RFC follow-up: proposal to extract the tenant capability/feature-gate logic out of runtime into a small capability service. aim is to make runtime stateless and easier to test.
jon: is this on the hotpath? worried about tail latency amplification. any perf budget numbers?
kevin: yes hotpath. strategy: keep runtime decision fast via local cache + short TTL + fallback to service. circuit-break if service latency > 200ms.
samira: migration path idea: start with read-side proxy in runtime (ff off), run dual-read and compare, then dual-write behind a flag. keep shim for one release.
leo: schema concerns: capability table shape + tenant overrides. we need compatibility guarantees. db migration must be rolling, avoid big locks.
mira: ownership: platform + auth. high-level checklist: create capability service + api, add adapter shim in runtime (ff=false), dual-read for 48h + diff metrics, dual-write for non-critical tenants, canary tenants, promote, remove shim.
kevin: caching proposal snippet: ```json
{
  "cache_ttl_secs": 5,
  "max_stale_secs": 30,
  "fallback_to_local": true,
  "circuit_threshold_ms": 200
}
```
jon: monitoring: p95 extra latency, mismatch rate between runtime and service, error rate, fallback hit %, cache hit ratio. create alerts: mismatch > 0.1% or fallback > 1%.
leo: SLA: capability service target 99.95. fallback policy during outage: safe-deny by default. exceptions for critical tenants via allowlist. include per-tenant policies in runbook.
samira: rollout runbook (stub): 1) deploy service to staging + smoke tests; 2) deploy runtime shim behind ff=false; 3) run dual-read 48h, collect diffs; 4) enable dual-write for non-critical tenants; 5) observe 72h, if divergence < 0.05% start canary; 6) canary -> 50% -> 100%; 7) remove shim after 1w stable.
infra-bot: pipeline kicked: build/capability-service #7890 -> staging.
jon: add /debug endpoint that returns decision source (local_cache | capability_service | fallback) for easier triage.
kevin: add metric: cache_hit_ratio per tenant + histogram of remote latency.
mira: failure modes to document: service slow -> circuit open -> runtime denies by default; cache corruption -> invalidate and roll back; divergence spikes -> pause dual-write. include rollback playbook.
leo: DB migration approach: introduce new columns with defaults, backfill in small batches, validate via checksum queries. avoid long-running transactions.
samira: also flagging: client SDKs should be unaffected; runtime adapter handles protocol translation. ensure api is gRPC+json-over-http shim.
mira: next steps: I'll draft RFC update with checklist, migration playbook, metric names, and a short runbook. looking for :+1: before I turn on dual-read.
jon: :thumbsup:
kevin: :+1:
samira: :raised_hands:
leo: +1
